pin_diff.note: Pin 4 differs (NC/NC vs NR/BYPASS): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=0 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 100x (TLV75533PDBVR: 1 µF p.4 vs TPS73633DBVR: 0 µF p.1); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS73633DBVR supplies up to 400 mA (p.4) compared to TLV75533PDBVR at 500 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (TLV75533PDBVR: 150 mV p.6 vs TPS73633DBVR: 75 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.
engineering_verdict: TLV75533PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS73633DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; minimum output capacitance requirement differs 100x; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 58.9 °C on TLV75533PDBVR (θJA 231.1 °C/W) vs 47.2 °C on TPS73633DBVR (θJA 185.2 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 16x ratio (25 µA (p.5) vs 400 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: TLV75533PDBVR "DBV Thermal Resistance (231.1 C/W JEDEC) vs Page-1 Headline 60.3 C/W (DYD Exposed-Pad Only)" (p.5) and TPS73633DBVR "Mixed New vs. Legacy Silicon Shipments Change Thermal Resistance" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TLV75533PDBVR when load current exceeds 400 mA (up to 500 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 25 µA Iq; choose TPS73633DBVR when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 75 mV dropout or lower package θJA (185.2 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
